title.zh-cn: 富士 XF16-50mmF2.8-4.8 R LM WR 官方规格

purpose.en: Verify actual focal-length endpoints, full-frame equivalent range, and endpoint aperture specifications.
purpose.zh-cn: 核实实际焦距端点、全画幅等效范围和端点光圈规格。

editorialNote.en: Only endpoint maximum apertures are listed; intermediate values are not inferred by interpolation.
